# Everyday posts

Simple starters for any channel: news, tips, stories and reminders.

8 templates. Square brackets are placeholders: replace every one before you post.

## Product launch (`launch`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Announce something new: what it is, who it helps and where to get it.

```text
It is here: [product name].

[One sentence on what it does and who it is for.]

What you get:
• [benefit one]
• [benefit two]
• [benefit three]

[Where to get it, or a link]
```

## Behind the scenes (`behindScenes`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Show the people and the work that usually stay out of sight.

```text
A look behind the scenes at [team or place].

This week we [what you worked on]. The part nobody sees: [a small detail, a habit or a mistake].

[What it means for the people you make it for.]
```

## Quick tip (`quickTip`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Teach one small thing people can use today.

```text
Quick tip: [the tip in one line].

Why it helps: [the problem it solves].

How to do it:
1. [step one]
2. [step two]
3. [step three]

Save this for later, and tell us how it went.
```

## Weekly roundup (`weeklyRoundup`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Gather the week's news, links or wins in one post.

```text
This week at [name]:

• [news or win one]
• [news or win two]
• [news or win three]

Coming up next week: [one line].

What was the best part of your week?
```

## Customer story (`customerStory`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Let a customer tell, in their own words, what changed for them.

```text
“[A short quote from the customer.]”

[Customer name] came to us because [their problem]. With [product or service] they now [the result, with a number if you have one].

Thank you for trusting us, [first name].
[Link to the full story]
```

## Event reminder (`eventReminder`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Remind people of the date, the time and how to join.

```text
Save the date: [event name]

When: [day, date and time]
Where: [place or link]

[One line on what people get from it.]

[How to sign up, and by when]
```

## Question for your audience (`question`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Start a conversation and hear what people think.

```text
We would love your view: [your question]?

A) [first option]
B) [second option]

Reply with A or B, or tell us what we missed. We read every answer.
```

## Milestone thank you (`milestone`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Mark a milestone and thank the people who got you there.

```text
We just reached [milestone].

That is thanks to you: [who helped, for example customers, readers or the team].

[One memory or lesson from the way here.]

Thank you. Next up: [what comes next].
```
